items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 26:1
items.html: The eighth correction of the beard and the thirteenth correction, which are the hairs of the beard of its upper and lower surface, which are long to the Chazeh and clothe in the aspect of surrounding [lights] over the HGT of AA to the Chazeh, are called the Mazal. And the Partzuf of AVI, which clothe the HGT of AA into their internality, are also included in the two Mazalot from the aspect of the surrounding ones, namely that these hairs serve AVI as surrounding [lights], just as they serve AA. And this is what was said, that AVI are included in the Mazal. (Vol. 1, p. 377, Item 173).
